title: Commitments
description: One living inbox for promises, requests, waiting, corrections, and follow-through.

blocks.title: Needs attention
blocks.intent: Maintain one reconciled list of explicit open commitments from the selected period. Use stable ids and the interactive item fields. Include requests to me, promises I made, waiting dependencies, and due work; never infer completion from silence.

blocks.title: Due now
blocks.intent: Count reconciled open commitments that are source-backed as due or overdue now. Do not count uncertain dates.

blocks.title: Waiting
blocks.intent: Count open commitments currently blocked by or delegated to someone else, using the same reconciled set as the inbox.

blocks.title: Needs review
blocks.intent: Count commitment candidates whose ownership, deadline, or open state still needs the user's review.

blocks.title: What changed
blocks.intent: Show only material source-backed commitment changes: created, deadline or owner changed, explicitly completed, cancelled, or reopened.

blocks.title: What Screenpipe could verify
blocks.intent: Explain the evidence boundary, uncertainty, and any important source gap behind this refresh in at most three short sentences.
